name: AI-Authorship and Linguistic-Feature Benchmark
description: "This dataset presents a controlled benchmark of 800 English essays designed for methodological research on AI-text detection, linguistic variation, algorithmic fairness, and authorship classification. The corpus contains 400 human_styleand 400 ai_style records representing synthetic generation regimes rather than verified human and machine authorship. Each record includes essay text, synthetic ground truth, language-group metadata, root type-token ratio (RTTR), sentence-level and syntactic-complexity indicators, and reference-model bigram perplexity. Four simulated detector configurations provide continuous scores and binary decisions, producing 3,200 detector-level observations suitable for ROC\/AUC analysis and generalized linear mixed-effects modeling. Additional files provide mediation-ready variables, detector configurations, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, false-positive rates, fairness comparisons, ROC coordinates, a data dictionary, and publication-style SVG figures. The benchmark is intended for statistical-pipeline validation, reproducibility studies, simulation experiments, and methodological development. All demographic variables, authorship conditions, essays, detector outputs, and performance statistics are synthetic and must not be interpreted as empirical observations of real individuals, populations, or commercial AI-detection systems."
